title: Claude Code monthly cost estimator | ModelFold
excerpt: Estimate a month of Claude Code API spend on ModelFold from published Claude token rates. Presets are planning assumptions, not a subscription price.
content_html:
ModelFold / Free calculators

This estimates API token spend when Claude Code calls ModelFold. It is not the price of a Claude subscription. Presets are planning assumptions you can edit. Each request is rounded up, then multiplied by days and requests.

Questions

Is this the Claude Pro subscription?

No. This is pay-per-token API usage on ModelFold. A Claude subscription is billed separately by Anthropic and is not included.

What do the presets assume?

Light is 20 days, 30 requests, 12,000 input tokens and 800 output tokens. Regular is 22 days, 80 requests, 25,000 in and 1,500 out. Heavy is 22 days, 160 requests, 50,000 in and 3,000 out.

How do I pay these prices in Claude Code?

Point Claude Code at the ModelFold Anthropic-compatible endpoint and use a ModelFold API key. The setup guide linked on this page has the steps.

Token cost calculatorModel price comparison

Create an account to get an API key and call the same models at the prices on this page. 200 credits = $1. Failed generations are not charged.
